statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail sits in the low band because CME equity futures are closed and Friday's observed tape was orderly, while Stress is high on the pre-FOMC rates and energy backdrop.
recommendation: Tail remains below the caution threshold, so the mapped state stays EA_ON across NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD. The one narrow flagged window is the 22:00-00:00 UTC Globex weekend reopen, where gap repricing risk is concentrated; the mapped state there is WATCH.
headline: Nasdaq-100 calm into a hawkish Fed week, with the Sunday futures reopen the near-term risk point
body: The Nasdaq-100 closed Friday at 29,368.44, up 0.91%, inside a narrow 29,313.51-29,473.12 range and about 105 points below the session high, so the index was not pinned at its extremes. VIX fell 11.2% to 15.84. That observed structure is orderly and retracement-friendly, which keeps Tail in the low band. The wider backdrop is considerably more tense: Treasury yields backed up sharply to 4.95% on the 10-year, 4.56% on the 2-year and 5.37% on the 30-year; WTI is near $100 and Brent near $104.6 after a roughly 9.7% weekly gain, with Strait of Hormuz traffic reported down about 95% and Gulf crude exports near half their pre-war level; and markets price roughly 85% odds of a 25 basis point rate hike at Wednesday's FOMC. Equities near highs with VIX under 16 against that backdrop is a thin cushion, which is why Stress is high while Tail is not. CME equity futures are shut until 22:00 UTC, so no live price path exists at assessment time and Confidence is held at solid rather than high. The weekend reopen is the single concentrated risk point inside the next 24 hours; Wednesday's multi-stage Fed sequence falls outside this window.

lookbackSummary: The previous 24 published hours were continuously available and uniformly green with the mapped state EA_ON. Tail was flat at 6 through the late Saturday and overnight hours, then drifted steadily higher from 05:00 UTC to reach 17 by 15:00 UTC as the weekend progressed toward the futures reopen. Stress rose in parallel from 50 to 70, tracking the accumulating pre-FOMC rates and energy backdrop, while the dominant mode stayed normal throughout and Confidence eased slightly from 87 to 85.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours split into three phases. Until 22:00 UTC the CME equity complex is closed and no price path can form, so Tail stays in the low band. The 22:00-00:00 UTC Globex reopen is the single concentrated risk point, where weekend Hormuz, Ukraine and Fed-expectation news is repriced into thin liquidity; Tail moves into the watch band for those two hours as a conditional gap allowance rather than an observed move. From early Asian hours onward the base case is absorption of the gap and a return to two-way, range-bound trade, with Tail decaying back toward 15-16 and a modest uptick around the European open and the 13:30 UTC US cash open. Monday carries no significant scheduled US macro, so residual risk is headline-driven. Stress stays high throughout because the underlying tension - a live hike debate, the 10-year near 5%, and crude near $100 - is unresolved. Confidence stays in the solid band all window: the verified cross-asset levels and calendar are good, but no live NQ price path exists at assessment time and the shared Finviz context was stale and partial.
